favourite.heading: Why Penn State can pull away
bullets: Penn State is the better football team by 23.7 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+23.7 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 9.7 points to Penn State (+9.7 pts).
Playing at Penn State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Penn State by 2.7 points: ball control vs front disruption (+2.7 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Buffalo can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 +17.2 to p90 +61.2 for Penn State, so a projection of +40.2 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
